definitions.gloss: backwardness; underdevelopment; slow progress; lagging behind
definitions.explanation: The state of progressing slowly or falling behind compared to others. Used for economic development, technology adoption, policy implementation, and other measurable domains.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅進|ちしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: Economic backwardness is a challenge in this region.

examples.japanese: ⟦デジタル{化|か}→デジタル化：08829_dejitaruka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅進|ちしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{競争力|きょうそうりょく}→競争力：27066_kyousouryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The slow progress of digitalization is affecting international competitiveness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅進|ちしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ようやく⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The slow progress on declining birthrate countermeasures has been pointed out for years, but serious efforts have finally begun.

notes:
Composed of {遅|ち} (slow, late) and {進|しん} (advance, progress). A formal word used in news, policy discussions, and academic contexts to describe falling behind in development or reform.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅進|ちしん}: economic backwardness
- {遅進|ちしん}{国|こく}: underdeveloped country
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅進|ちしん}: technological lag
- {遅進|ちしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧: to make up for lost ground

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後進|こうしん}: backwardness, underdevelopment — more common synonym
- ⟦{停滞|ていたい}→停滞：07427_teitai⟧: stagnation — implies no movement at all, not just slow movement
- ⟦{遅延|ちえん}→遅延：06749_chien⟧: delay — focuses on timing rather than development level
